description:
Title: Luxury Airplane

You produce airplanes.
While the base model is always the same, your customer likes to pimp their airplane with fancy interior.
You let them decide between a number of 5 different bars, the number of seats, their color, and the amount of water in the toilets of their plane (you can come up with additional stuff).
After you received the specifications you send the requirements to different teams to manufacture the parts.
E.g. manufacturing the vodka bar is done by the Russian team, the whiskey bar is manufactured by an Irish team.
After receiving the individual bits and pieces, the interior of the plane is assembled, and the plane is sent on a test flight.
During the flight you create a test protocol which is sent to you and the customer.
The plane is delivered to the customer, which has to confirm.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_LuxuryAirplane" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/luxury-airplane">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Specs" name="Customer specifications"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Requirements" name="Part requirements"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Parts" name="Manufactured parts"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_TestProtocol" name="Test protocol"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Delivery" name="Airplane delivery"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Confirmation" name="Delivery confirmation"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collab_LuxuryAirplane">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Manufacturer" name="Airplane Manufacturer" processRef="Process_Manufacturer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Teams" name="Manufacturing Teams"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Specs" name="Specifications" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveSpecs" messageRef="Msg_Specs"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Requirements" name="Requirements" sourceRef="Task_SendRequirements" targetRef="Participant_Teams" messageRef="Msg_Requirements"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Parts" name="Parts" sourceRef="Participant_Teams" targetRef="Task_ReceiveParts" messageRef="Msg_Parts"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Protocol" name="Test protocol" sourceRef="Task_SendProtocol" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Msg_TestProtocol"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Delivery" name="Delivery" sourceRef="Task_DeliverPlane" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Msg_Delivery"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Confirmation" name="Confirmation" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveConfirmation" messageRef="Msg_Confirmation"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Manufacturer" name="Luxury Airplane Manufacturing" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Order" name="Order started"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveSpecs" name="Receive interior specifications" messageRef="Msg_Specs"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRequirements" name="Send requirements to manufacturing teams" messageRef="Msg_Requirements"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveParts" name="Receive manufactured parts" messageRef="Msg_Parts"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssembleInterior" name="Assemble interior"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestFlight" name="Perform test flight"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateProtocol" name="Create test protocol during flight">
      <bpmn:documentation>The protocol is also kept by the manufacturer.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendProtocol" name="Send test protocol to customer" messageRef="Msg_TestProtocol"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_DeliverPlane" name="Deliver airplane to customer" messageRef="Msg_Delivery"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveConfirmation" name="Receive delivery confirmation" messageRef="Msg_Confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Delivered" name="Airplane delivery confirmed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Order" targetRef="Task_ReceiveSpecs"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveSpecs" targetRef="Task_SendRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_SendRequirements" targetRef="Task_ReceiveParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveParts" targetRef="Task_AssembleInterior"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_AssembleInterior" targetRef="Task_TestFlight"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_TestFlight" targetRef="Task_CreateProtocol"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_CreateProtocol" targetRef="Task_SendProtocol"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Task_SendProtocol" targetRef="Task_DeliverPlane"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Task_DeliverPlane" targetRef="Task_ReceiveConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveConfirmation" targetRef="EndEvent_Delivered"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
